text:
Sam: quick heads up — PR #8421 addresses a DB-churn issue that spiked p99 latency for tokenization requests. Can someone take a quick look and approve? small change + test. https://github.com/redwoodinc/infra/pull/8421
Priya: on it, pulling the diff now
Ethan: pinging @Priya — if you need a hand I can carve out 10m
Priya: quick question: I see retries went 3 -> 1. Why drop retries instead of increasing backoff/jitter?
Sam: good call — logs showed a tight retry loop from many clients causing DB contention. Lowering retries buys immediate relief. Follow-up will add exponential backoff/jitter. This is a hot mitigation for INC-3412
Priya: unit tests look fine. small nit: can you add a one-line comment referencing INC-3412 so it's obvious in the diff?
Sam: will add now
Sam: added comment + changelog entry. Diff snippet:
```diff
- retries = 3
+ retries = 1  # INC-3412: reduce client churn; follow-up: implement exponential backoff with jitter
```
deploy-bot: canary build queued for infra/PR-8421 (build 5623) — tagging @eng-oncall
Maya: reviewing, left one inline about the magic number, otherwise looks clean
Ethan: +1 to merge after canary clears. Can someone watch p99 for the next 30m?
Priya: I'll monitor logs and have alerts ready; will escalate if error rate or p99 > 1.5x baseline
Sam: thanks. merging on green. request: deploy-bot, kick off a short canary and monitor
deploy-bot: canary started — monitoring enabled. Alerting set to notify #eng-oncall on >0.5% errors sustained for 5m
Maya: LGTM, approving now
Sam: merged and canary rolling. Keeping an eye on graphs
Priya: looks better — p99 back around baseline after ~8m :tada:
Ethan: awesome, thanks everyone. We'll follow up with an RFC for the backoff change and link to INC-3412 for context
Sam: thanks all for quick eyes and monitoring
